recent_moves: 2016 — partnered Nykaa on a 10-year exclusive-portfolio agreement (2016-2026), India's largest Korean assortment [CORRIDOR]
2025 — launched Mise En Scène and RYO (hair care) via Nykaa [CORRIDOR]
2026 — launched Illiyoon (dermocosmetics) as a Nykaa exclusive [CORRIDOR]
corridor_involvement: The corridor's anchor principal. Its Nykaa partnership (2016-2026) built India's largest Korean portfolio — Innisfree, Laneige, Sulwhasoo, COSRX, Aestura, now Illiyoon — and corridor.yaml records that it is scaling India via platforms and imports, NOT local manufacturing, with no India plant announced. Its owned brands are also the deepest-stocked K-brands on the q-commerce rail (Laneige 16 SKUs, Etude 10, Innisfree 9 on Blinkit, 2026-07-23), while its COSRX acquisition sits out-of-stock on the same capture.
read: Korea's #1 brand owner on a premium basis — 22% of Korean premium BPC (Euromonitor, HIGH) — with KRW 4.253tn consolidated revenue in 2025, reported up 9.5% YoY on operating profit of KRW 335.8bn, +52.3%. That recovery is real but it is measured against a damaged base: the group's own Innisfree fell to KRW 224.6bn in FY24, -18%, from a KRW 768bn peak in 2016 as the road-shop model collapsed. For an entrant the relevant fact is structural rather than financial: AmorePacific enters India through platform partnerships and imports, so it holds shelf and conduit position without owning any Indian manufacturing — a position that is rentable, contestable, and, with the Nykaa term expiring in 2026, currently in play.
